raw: [name="Theresis"]Our project is near to its close.
speaker: Theresis
content: Our project is near to its close.

raw: [name="Theresa"]I hear the sound of the storm, and so do they.
speaker: Theresa
content: I hear the sound of the storm, and so do they.

raw: [name="Theresa"]They're telling me now, how they like this sound. They're dying to become a part of the storm, to howl wantonly through the air, to go and devour this hateful city before us.
speaker: Theresa
content: They're telling me now, how they like this sound. They're dying to become a part of the storm, to howl wantonly through the air, to go and devour this hateful city before us.

speaker: Theresis
content: Perfect.

raw: [name="Theresis"]In ten days, our airship will be complete. From there, they'll be able to take to Londinium's skies, and serve as the storm's very pilots.
speaker: Theresis
content: In ten days, our airship will be complete. From there, they'll be able to take to Londinium's skies, and serve as the storm's very pilots.

speaker: Theresa
content: I'll be going with them.

raw: [name="Theresis"]That suits our plan. You are the optimal candidate to command our air forces, given I must be defending The Shard.
speaker: Theresis
content: That suits our plan. You are the optimal candidate to command our air forces, given I must be defending The Shard.

raw: [name="Theresa"]No, Theresis, that isn't what I mean.
speaker: Theresa
content: No, Theresis, that isn't what I mean.

raw: [name="Theresa"]They and I, as one, can but only go together.
speaker: Theresa
content: They and I, as one, can but only go together.

speaker: Theresis
content: Good.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Prior to their departure, you are to continue fulfilling your duty.
speaker: Theresis
content: Prior to their departure, you are to continue fulfilling your duty.

raw: [name="Theresis"]The Royal Court needs you, and our soldiers need their most trustworthy monarch.
speaker: Theresis
content: The Royal Court needs you, and our soldiers need their most trustworthy monarch.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Moreover, you are more proficient in building than I am, by all rights. Our construction rate has sped up by ten percent since you began attending Court meetings.
speaker: Theresis
content: Moreover, you are more proficient in building than I am, by all rights. Our construction rate has sped up by ten percent since you began attending Court meetings.

raw: [name="Theresa"]I would not forget what I am meant to do.
speaker: Theresa
content: I would not forget what I am meant to do.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Also. I noticed you deposed of those... guards. The Confessarii have given you no end of grief for that, have they?
speaker: Theresa
content: Also. I noticed you deposed of those... guards. The Confessarii have given you no end of grief for that, have they?

raw: [name="Theresis"]Deposing of the guards about you was the Military Commission's decision. We need more sentries, so we can answer to the greatest period of danger.
speaker: Theresis
content: Deposing of the guards about you was the Military Commission's decision. We need more sentries, so we can answer to the greatest period of danger.

raw: [name="Theresa"]If needs be, I can enter the battlefield too.
speaker: Theresa
content: If needs be, I can enter the battlefield too.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Stay here. This tower... and the airship. Those lie at the core of our plans.
speaker: Theresis
content: Stay here. This tower... and the airship. Those lie at the core of our plans.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Once these two projects are through and done with, Kazdel will possess the power to fend off all nations.
speaker: Theresis
content: Once these two projects are through and done with, Kazdel will possess the power to fend off all nations.

speaker: Theresa
content: Fend off all nations, you say...

raw: [name="Theresa"]I've always known of your ambitions, but it makes it no less unbelievable to hear every time.
speaker: Theresa
content: I've always known of your ambitions, but it makes it no less unbelievable to hear every time.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Hasn't it always plagued you that they would not permit us to rise again?
speaker: Theresis
content: Hasn't it always plagued you that they would not permit us to rise again?

raw: [name="Theresis"]Very soon, you will be plagued no longer.
speaker: Theresis
content: Very soon, you will be plagued no longer.

speaker: Theresa
content: Indeed.

raw: [name="Theresa"]—If even the bearing of the storm is ours to control, who would still be occupied by the dark clouds floating at its head?
speaker: Theresa
content: —If even the bearing of the storm is ours to control, who would still be occupied by the dark clouds floating at its head?

raw: [name="Theresis"]In the past, we Sarkaz let our enemies pursue us.
speaker: Theresis
content: In the past, we Sarkaz let our enemies pursue us.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Time and time again we stood up in the ruins, and time again we rebuilt our homeland, and time again we watched our home be torn to shreds by the wars they incited.
speaker: Theresis
content: Time and time again we stood up in the ruins, and time again we rebuilt our homeland, and time again we watched our home be torn to shreds by the wars they incited.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Sarkaz... Sarkaz. We are a rootless people.
speaker: Theresa
content: Sarkaz... Sarkaz. We are a rootless people.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Why is that? Solely because they have occupied our finest soil, and forbid our roots to take.
speaker: Theresis
content: Why is that? Solely because they have occupied our finest soil, and forbid our roots to take.

raw: [name="Theresis"]In the war two hundred years ago, it took all our might to drive the enemy back—yet we still could not preserve Kazdel.
speaker: Theresis
content: In the war two hundred years ago, it took all our might to drive the enemy back—yet we still could not preserve Kazdel.

raw: [name="Theresis"]After that, how much time did we have to devote, to just about reconvene our stranded remnants?
speaker: Theresis
content: After that, how much time did we have to devote, to just about reconvene our stranded remnants?

speaker: Theresis
content: And how much more time—

raw: [name="Theresis"]To transport these bare shreds Victoria and Ursus could not see to a wasteland they were just as blind to, and rebuild Kazdel again right under their very noses?
speaker: Theresis
content: To transport these bare shreds Victoria and Ursus could not see to a wasteland they were just as blind to, and rebuild Kazdel again right under their very noses?

speaker: Theresa
content: Two hundred years?

raw: [name="Theresis"]Yes. It has taken us these two full centuries.
speaker: Theresis
content: Yes. It has taken us these two full centuries.

raw: [name="Theresis"]So what of the next time? Suppose our Kazdel is once again razed by flames of war? How much more time will we need to rebuild it?
speaker: Theresis
content: So what of the next time? Suppose our Kazdel is once again razed by flames of war? How much more time will we need to rebuild it?

speaker: Theresis
content: Now five hundred years—or even longer?

raw: [name="Theresis"]Our enemies have almost gotten away with this, precisely because we've become accustomed to drifting.
speaker: Theresis
content: Our enemies have almost gotten away with this, precisely because we've become accustomed to drifting.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Ruination after ruination may never snuff out the Sarkaz soul, but it has unarguably scattered us.
speaker: Theresis
content: Ruination after ruination may never snuff out the Sarkaz soul, but it has unarguably scattered us.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Kazdel today is merely crammed with houses. It is not home.
speaker: Theresis
content: Kazdel today is merely crammed with houses. It is not home.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Still more Sarkaz wander the great land beyond, no dreams in their mind's eye further than tomorrow's bread.
speaker: Theresis
content: Still more Sarkaz wander the great land beyond, no dreams in their mind's eye further than tomorrow's bread.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Even the Royal Court... All Kazdel has is its Ten Kings' Court of tradition, and the majority of those ten have left their positions vacant.
speaker: Theresis
content: Even the Royal Court... All Kazdel has is its Ten Kings' Court of tradition, and the majority of those ten have left their positions vacant.

speaker: Theresa
content: This is why you wanted war.

raw: [name="Theresis"]It is not my want, but the Sarkaz's need.
speaker: Theresis
content: It is not my want, but the Sarkaz's need.

raw: [name="Theresis"]This time, it will be beneath our feet where war's flames ignite. Victoria, Ursus, Leithanien... not one city, not one patch of soil will be fortunate enough to escape.
speaker: Theresis
content: This time, it will be beneath our feet where war's flames ignite. Victoria, Ursus, Leithanien... not one city, not one patch of soil will be fortunate enough to escape.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Within the next century, our enemies will no longer have the energy left to set their sights on Kazdel.
speaker: Theresis
content: Within the next century, our enemies will no longer have the energy left to set their sights on Kazdel.

raw: [name="Theresis"]No, more than that. Once we have the ability to guide the storm—they'll come to fear the Sarkaz's gaze instead, just as they fear the storm descending.
speaker: Theresis
content: No, more than that. Once we have the ability to guide the storm—they'll come to fear the Sarkaz's gaze instead, just as they fear the storm descending.

raw: [name="Theresa"]The storm... gathers atop this tower we stand in.
speaker: Theresa
content: The storm... gathers atop this tower we stand in.

raw: [name="Theresa"]They will see us, stood in the storm's eye. Every enemy of the Sarkaz will throw themselves at us with all they have, to stop us.
speaker: Theresa
content: They will see us, stood in the storm's eye. Every enemy of the Sarkaz will throw themselves at us with all they have, to stop us.

speaker: Theresis
content: Then let them.

raw: [name="Theresa"]You... Don't you fear the inferno consuming your body too, when the first thunderbolt strikes?
speaker: Theresa
content: You... Don't you fear the inferno consuming your body too, when the first thunderbolt strikes?

raw: [name="Theresis"]When you built Babel, you too knew all opposers would point their swords at you—and did you ever once fear?
speaker: Theresis
content: When you built Babel, you too knew all opposers would point their swords at you—and did you ever once fear?

raw: [name="Theresis"]The tower you built with life has collapsed, just like another Kazdel.
speaker: Theresis
content: The tower you built with life has collapsed, just like another Kazdel.

raw: [name="Theresis"]And at this moment, we stand here—in a new tower, in a new opportunity.
speaker: Theresis
content: And at this moment, we stand here—in a new tower, in a new opportunity.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Look at Londinium today. You only just presided over the meeting of the kings. How can you not have realized?
speaker: Theresis
content: Look at Londinium today. You only just presided over the meeting of the kings. How can you not have realized?

raw: [name="Theresis"]Not even before the useless war between us began, were the Sarkaz so close to unity.
speaker: Theresis
content: Not even before the useless war between us began, were the Sarkaz so close to unity.

speaker: Theresa
content: And very, very many will die.

raw: [name="Theresa"]So many... Victorians, and so many Sarkaz. The people's blood will change this grey city through and through, and their wails will cover even the thunder.
speaker: Theresa
content: So many... Victorians, and so many Sarkaz. The people's blood will change this grey city through and through, and their wails will cover even the thunder.

raw: [name="Theresis"]This is a war. A war between us and them, one continued for centuries, without end.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Single out the dangers of my plan, just as you have countless times before.

speaker: Theresa
content: I have no objections.
